data.long_meaning: Khush is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Khus’, which means happiness, joy, or contentment. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is often referred to as ‘Khusakar’, the giver of happiness and prosperity. The name Khush carries the meaning “Happiness, Joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Khush usually hope their child will grow to embody happiness, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
